title: Future daytime events are labelled by time of day rather than Tonight

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04 audit and approved improvement scope

detail: Current source puts all later same-day events into the Tonight slot, including future morning/noon events. Historical local candidate94135d44e exists; reconcile it with fresh main and current planner label before implementing anew. No current canonical row covers this daytime-label defect; old LIVE-079 concerns a different midnight-boundary issue. Built 2026-11-09 (PR pending the merge queue): a later-today event's when label names its part of the day from its wall-clock start (This morning before noon, This afternoon until 5pm, Tonight from 5pm), and the planner's later-today tab reads Later today instead of Tonight, so a 9am class under it is not called tonight anywhere. Slots, ranking, the two-hour Now window, Tomorrow and the weekday labels are unchanged; the Caught up card already lower-cases the when label into its sentence. Pinned by lib/feed/home-rank.test.ts (the when label at a 7am wall clock). The historical candidate 94135d44e is not in the repository or on any remote branch; this is a fresh build on main. Manual acceptance after deploy stays with the owner: on a morning, /feed Near you shows a 10am event as This morning 10am under Later today.

verify.evidence: Source-confirmed home-rank.ts and planner label; earlier production audit observed9am/noon events under Tonight. Acceptance: future daytime/evening and midnight boundaries in Space/viewer time zones, preserved ranking, rendered labels and exact deployed behavior. Historical candidate focused tests are not current-head production proof.
